reviews.review:
While there are certainly a lot of things that could be better (don't even get me started on the dialogue and facial expressions), but for someone who has never played a Mass Effect title, I'm having a lot of fun. Combat feels good, the worlds are gorgeous and the story is fairly solid.

If you're just looking for a chill RPG experience, I'd say definitely give this a try while it's on sale.

Sadly, the origin installer is so broken and forces you to update (which fails) that you cannot play the game. But the game itself is great.

In the past, the Steam Framework soemhow bypassed the origin starter bug, allowing me to play it. Not, I get error codes 16:-1 and 9:0. No clue why EA is to lazy to write a HUMAN READABLE ERROR instead of sending the user on a wilde goose chase with arbitrary error codes. I gave up trying. Reminder to me: no EA games in the future.

Tried again in 2023. Ran for  a few day. New error:
Windows:
This file does not have a program associated with it for perfomring this action. Please install a programm or, if one is already installed, create an association in the Default Programs control panel.

Steam:
Failed to start process for Mass Effect(TM): Andromeda Deluxe Edition:
No application is associated with the specified file for this operation (0x483)

Steam suggestion: reinstall (f... 45 GB?! )

I will stay with my decision: no EA games via steam. The break their bridge too often. "You had one job(TM)... and you failed."

[h1] Don't Believe All The Negativity [/h1]

Overall, this game is a great experience. The story is decent, gameplay (user experience, interactions, interface, modularity, etc.) is good, and combat is excellent. I don't understand why there's so much hate regarding Andromeda. I'd say it comes from the unwillingness of a Trilogy player to accept the changes laid before them. I myself have played the original Mass Effect Trilogy and can guarantee that this game has more to offer than what most are letting on. In all honesty, this game hooked me in just like the Mass Effect games previous and I still continue to play it despite the problems I've encountered so far. However, it's not like Andromeda is the only one with problems in this series...

[h1] The Real Implications [/h1]

Okay, so, the first real problem I've encountered so far with the game is the fact that it tends to freeze/crash on a slightly regular basis. Now, it doesn't freeze or crash every five minutes, but sometimes that can happen. It happens randomly at irregular intervals. Doesn't matter what you do, where you are, or how you did something, it might just freeze or crash. I've done many things to try and fix this such as dropping back to stock clocks, uninstalling/reinstalling my display driver, and running system file checker but to no avail. I might just uninstall and reinstall this game, or better yet, reset windows entirely. It's a sacrifice i'm willing to make but would not be convenient for me right now.

Second, are the animations. They're...okay? They could pass as decent but with a game that came out near the end of the decade you'd think they'd have gotten facial animation and hand gestures down by now. In my experience, I've gotten used to them, I wouldn't worry too much.

[h1] In The End [/h1]

Play it, you won't regret it. If you do, just refund it and move on with your life. Simple as that.
